results.title: Sudurpaschim close in on Qualifier after thrilling win over Kathmandu
results.content: Sudurpaschim Royals have won four consecutive matches after losing two of their first three, moving to the top of the Nepal Premier League table with 10 points.

results.title: Dipendra’s half-century helps Sudurpaschim set Kathmandu modest 126-run target
results.content: The Royals recover from a disastrous start but manage only 125 for six in their 20 overs in the first match of Friday’s double-header.

results.title: Chhath preparations gather pace in Kathmandu
results.content: Markets are filling with shoppers buying fruits, traditional offerings and bamboo items ahead of the festival.

results.title: Lukla sees a rush of tourists as trekking season picks up
results.content: Growing numbers of international visitors are crowding the mountain airport, with limited flights making tickets to and from Kathmandu harder to secure.

results.title: International cricketers fall in love with Nepal beyond TU Ground
results.content: Whether flying over the mountains, enjoying the snow-capped views from hotel balconies or team outings in the hills around the Kathmandu Valley, overseas talents savour life off the pitch.

results.title: Kathmandu airport unable to collect Rs1.5 billion from 42 entities
results.content: The airport customs office, Himalaya Airlines and Hotel Radisson alone account for nearly 73 percent of the total outstanding dues, amounting to more than Rs1.14 billion.

results.title: Nepali workers make a living on Kedarnath’s 22-kilometre trail
results.content: More than 2,000 Nepalis travel to the Indian pilgrimage site in season to carry pilgrims and goods, while others run hotels and shops.

results.title: The Nepali border villages that empty for six months every year
results.content: Every year, residents of Chhangru and Tinkar in Darchula leave their homes for the lowlands and return in spring when the snow recedes.

results.title: Nepali negotiators at COP31 cling to hope for mountain agenda
results.content: Nepal, Bhutan and other mountain countries are pushing for measures to save glaciers and mountain ecosystems.

results.title: Chhath has spread across Nepal. State support has not
results.content: A fairer holiday, safer travel and lasting infrastructure would be a start.

results.title: Are Nepal’s celebrated technocrats serving the country or global capital?
results.content: From Ram Sharan Mahat’s Banker award to Swarnim Wagle’s TIME100 nod, global honours for Nepali technocrats signal alignment with Western financial orthodoxy, not necessarily service to Nepal’s people.

results.title: How Mamta Kafle case shows why digital records matter when a Nepali disappears abroad
results.content: The Mamta Kafle Bhatt case was not a digital-inheritance dispute, but a photo she asked her brother to preserve shows why a record can matter long after it is shared.

results.title: Nepal still has few large employers after 35 years of liberalisation
results.content: Around 500,000 young people enter the labour market every year, but only a handful of business groups employ more than 10,000 people each.

results.title: Lumbini Lions seal playoff spot as Karnali Yaks suffer fourth straight defeat
results.content: The defending champions climbed to the top of the Nepal Premier League standings with a six-wicket win, while Karnali’s hopes of reaching the playoffs suffered another setback.

results.title: Madhesh chief minister to seek confidence vote on November 14
results.content: Chief Minister Krishna Prasad Yadav is seeking a vote of confidence after the CPN-UML and Nepali Communist Party, both members of his coalition government, withdrew their support.

results.title: 11 of 13 killed in Makawanpur microbus crash identified
results.content: The electric minibus was travelling from Kathmandu to Sarlahi when it plunged off the road at Chisapanigadhi along the Bhimphedi-Kulekhani-Kathmandu road section at around 5:45 am on Thursday.

results.title: Why Chhath is more than a day on Nepal’s calendar
results.content: Nepal’s treatment of the five-day festival exposes deeper failures in recognising Madheshi heritage, addressing gender inequality, ensuring caste inclusion and protecting the environment.

results.title: Crossing the border for a better education
results.content: From village schools in Jhapa and Bardiya to CBSE institutions in Birgunj, children from neighbouring Indian communities are crossing into Nepal daily in search of better schooling.

results.title: Nepal seeks mountain-specific early warning systems after devastating flood
results.content: Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal calls for better cross-border data sharing, improved high-altitude monitoring and predictable climate finance to protect vulnerable communities.

results.title: UN chief urges climate justice and greater support for vulnerable countries
results.content: Guterres warns climate action is falling behind as Nepal presses for greater recognition of Himalayan vulnerabilities.
